topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe someone actually went and got a tattoo of my artwork. It's... wow, flattering, really. I mean, sure, it's a little weird, and I wish they'd maybe checked in or something. But also, it’s kind of amazing, you know? That they loved it enough to do that. I don’t know if I should be flattered or a little miffed. Probably a bit of both. Whatever it is, it’s a reminder to take my work seriously, and maybe reach out to them, too. See what the story is behind it. Might make for a good piece of my own.
